rules: Every living unit MUST render as .rp-arena-unit inside its pad — not as a floating card row.
Placement confirm writes neighborId → padId; fight reads the same map (no re-layout shuffle).
HP bar + role chip sit on the pad unit; damage floats anchor to pad center.
If Meshy arena hero present (wave3), use as full-bleed stage under pads; pads are interaction plane.
